probes.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the nodes, the flows, the stages and the total, the largest flow with its share of the source and the node where the most arrives; a bar per node, a band per flow, names and values beside the nodes, the first node in the first colour

probes.title: Right walks along the largest flows, each node said with what comes in from where and what goes out to where, the three largest each way; Left goes back along the largest incoming flow; Enter chooses the node; Escape clears

steps.script: (() => { window.__chosen = null; document.querySelector('#c').addEventListener('sf-chart-sankey-select', (event) => { window.__chosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]').focus(); return true; })()
